effect.cosmopolitan.abysmal_torch.descri: Summons a temporary glowing block upon killing a monster. While in The Undergarden, this block also provides healing.
effect.cosmopolitan.carotene.description: This effect activates after the player has consumed enough carrot-based food, canceling the flickering of the Night Vision and converting some of the visual obstruction effects to Night Vision.
effect.cosmopolitan.exuberant.descriptio: Gain a small amount of extra health at the end of the duration. It will be removed if the user takes damage before it ends.
effect.cosmopolitan.ingrained.descriptio: Reduces incoming damage depending on the user's current Y level.
effect.cosmopolitan.marked.description: The user will leave a glowing trail on the blocks they pass over.
effect.cosmopolitan.phototaxis.descripti: Increases attack and mining speed depending on the user's surrounding light level.
effect.cosmopolitan.placeholder.descript: The original effect of the item could not be applied because the compatible mod was not installed.
effect.cosmopolitan.tracer.description: The user's ranged attack will mark and blind the first living target they hit.
effect.cosmopolitan.vardoger.description: When the user attacks or takes damage, the outgoing damage has a chance to be doubled. While in The Undergarden, this extra damage becomes an explosion.

jei.cosmopolitan.cream_bucket.desc: Cream can be used in crafting recipes in place of milk; foods crafted with it will restore extra hunger points.
jei.cosmopolitan.fiddlehead.desc: Fiddlehead can be dropped when breaking fern or large fern.
jei.cosmopolitan.frozen_dessert_tub.desc: アイスタッパーは、Neapolitanやアドオンで追加されるアイスクリームをクラフト・保存するための特殊なブロックです。まずは牛乳をタッパーに注ぎ、砂糖を加えて練乳を作ります。蓋を閉めると、練乳は徐々にクリーム状へと変化します。その状態で近くに氷や雪のブロックを置き、味付けとなる材料をクリームに加えると、アイスクリームが出来上がります。
jei.cosmopolitan.gulime.desc: 食用ゴーレムの一種で、食べると4体に分裂します。小さな個体がインベントリに4体以上存在する場合、ゆっくりと再生します。再生した地点のバイオームによって、違う姿になるかもしれません。
jei.cosmopolitan.wandering_gelato.desc: 行商人は新しい食べ物を販売しています。
jei.cosmopolitan.wheatgrass.desc: Wheatgrass can be obtained by harvesting a wheat crop that is in the middle of its growth phase.
jei.cosmopolitan.wildberry.desc: Wildberry can be dropped when breaking grass or tall grass.
tooltip.cosmopolitan.cream.when_consumed: Randomly increases or decreases the duration of 1 effect
tooltip.cosmopolitan.cream_bucket.when_c: Randomly increases or decreases the duration of all effects
tooltip.cosmopolitan.wheatgrass.when_fee: When fed to a tamed Cat:
